invariant: Java tries UML factories in order and the class factory accepts ordinary package blocks, quoted symbol-container commands through CommandPackageWithUSymbol, class declarations, and class relationships in one source. A quoted node/frame/cloud container is therefore not a deployment discriminator when explicit non-interface class declarations make the complete source valid for ClassDiagramFactory. Deployment-only containers remain deployment signals when no class declarations establish the earlier class grammar.
causal_divergence: Rust initially scores each class declaration strongly, but then unconditionally promotes a quoted deployment container above every other subtype. When an ordinary package container is also present it instead unconditionally promotes COMPONENT. Fresh valid matrices containing quoted node/frame/cloud containers plus classes consequently render as DESCRIPTION while Java renders CLASS. Unquoted forms already pass, proving the renderer geometry is reached correctly once dispatch selects Class.
planned_change: Prevent the late quoted-deployment and component-container tie-break promotions from overriding explicit non-interface class declarations. Preserve their existing behavior when no such class declaration exists. Add subtype tests crossing quoted shared containers with class declarations and true deployment-only controls.
